Description: The Government issued ORI or Oeang Repoeblik Indonesia. But at that time the state of the country which was still chaotic made the circulation of ORI somewhat stagnant. Even so ORI is still being circulated because it is proven to be able to increase the solidarity and nationalism of the Indonesian people.
To be more effective in 1947 the Government finally imposed the respective regional currencies especially Sumatra Banten Tapanuli and Banda Aceh for the time being by circulating the ORIDA currency
This series has very odd nominal fractions namely Rp. 00 Rp. 75.00 Rp. 100.00 Hatta Rp. 400.00 and one of the best and rarest works as well as the most expensive price nominal 600 rupiah (unissued).
The presence of the Suharto government for 32 years contributed greatly to the change in the Rupiah. It was signed by Bank Indonesia Governor Radius Prawiro and BI Director Soeksmono B Martokoesoemo.

BI issued a 1000-rupiah bill with the image of Pangeran Diponegoro 5000 rupiah with a picture of Fishermen and a 10000 rupiah fraction with the relief of Borobudur Temple. signed by BI Governor Rachmat Saleh and Director of BI Soeksmono B Martokoesoemo.

In 1992 he published a new series of money with the emission of 1992. Consisting of 100 rupiah fractions with Phinisi boats 500 rupiahs with Orang Utan 1000 rupiahs with Lake Toba 5000 rupiahs with Sasando musical instruments and Rote 10000 rupiahs with Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono IX and a 20000 rupiah fraction with a red Bird of Paradise picture.
Also issued special publications with the same fractions and images but made of polymeric materials with safety in the form of Soeharto's "holographic" not watermarks as is commonly used.

This Reform Order was a lot of money that we know today. 100000 rupiah fragments emitting 1999 with the picture of Soekarno Muh. Hatta and the text of the proclamation were circulated. The fraction is printed in Australia and Thailand is plastic (Polymer).
The latest editions of Rupiah issued by Bank Indonesia during Jokowi's administration. It has a rejuvenation of forms from before. Using a new style but still use the same hero image
